Body.Content:
Business value

Mobile offline profile design can affect first sync, ongoing sync cost, app responsiveness, and reliability. Administrators and makers often need to balance business data requirements with profile complexity, related data, and performance considerations.

AI-assisted recommendations will help app makers identify opportunities to improve mobile offline profile design while creating or editing profiles. This can reduce trial and error, help customers deploy better-performing offline apps faster, and surface potential sync issues earlier in the app lifecycle.

Feature detail

App makers will receive AI-assisted recommendations while creating or editing mobile offline profiles. Recommendations can help identify configuration patterns that may increase sync cost, affect performance, or create reliability risks.

The experience is intended to guide profile optimization by highlighting opportunities to simplify profile design, reduce unnecessary sync work, and avoid configuration patterns that can impact mobile offline behavior. Makers remain responsible for reviewing recommendations and choosing the configuration that matches their business requirements.

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
